title: Travel and Tour Assistant
tagline: A Travel Assistant DApp that users can rely on to get information from google maps for places, hotels, restaurants,s, and cool tourism sites.
description: A Travel Assistant DApp that users can rely on to get information from google maps for places, hotels, restaurants,s, and cool tourism sites. An intending tourist guide can register on the site and will get mapped or assigned a user when a user requests to hire one. The users login with a web3 wallet and get assigned or mapped to a tourist guide. The user accepts their agreement by making payment to the tourist guide in real-time using superfluid services.
how_its_made: The smart contract was written in solidity to control the registration and streaming of rewards to tour guides from users. the front end was done using React. The Mapping services were done using google API services, the weather services were also gotten from the Rapid API. Rapid API also was used to get the list of Covid-19 details.
